title: Item tool: read queries
description: Why read can't compute completion, and the fix.

add.text:
- **What happens:** `read` only walks **data fields**, so `completion_score` comes back as "no such path".
- **But it's there:** the tool does build a real Session server-side, with the method on it.
- **Today's workaround:** calling the method as a delta *writes a log line*, so it isn't safe.
add.title: Problem
Proposed shape

add.text:
- **Each step of a read path:** a field, then a child, then a **query** method. Nothing else.
- **Queries are declared** on the class (`static queries`), never guessed.
- **Session extends Task**, so every session gets completion and cost built in.
- **Status:** sent to page-design. It needs the Servex restart.
